conclusion: Rollback-only candidate and immutable registration passed for semantic_ddo_viewbind_v1 after semantic_ddo_sources_v1. Original-source binding preserves the consumer scope equality for ordinary same-subject inputs; an explicit declared subject-field association can select authenticated frozen views of the same actual document without rewriting their distinct analyzed scopes. Exact field/subject association, original source, kind/origin, project, selected admission, read boundary and current trust checks remain. All three native transitions preserve ACLs and owners.
